Line 8. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P07-007, status approved, budget 9274 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P07-008, status approved, budget 3364 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
